usage: The word '蟋蟀' is used as a noun to refer to the insect known as a cricket.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence, for example, '蟋蟀喺草叢度叫' means 'The cricket is chirping in the grass'.
'蟋蟀' is countable as an animal; you can say '一隻蟋蟀' to mean 'one cricket'.
In casual conversation, it often appears when talking about sounds of insects or when describing a natural environment.
It can be combined with verbs like '聽' (to hear) or '捉' (to catch) to form common phrases.
